subject: SOC 2 Type II: onboarding intake, coverage clarification, and evidence share options
content:
From: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@acmetech.com>
To: aditya_rao@redwood.com
Cc: BrightPath Audits <audits@brightpath.com>
Date: Sat, 10 Jan 2027 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: SOC 2 Type II — initial ask + audit period question

Hi Aditya,

We're kicking off our vendor review for Acme's platform integrations and need your SOC 2 Type II materials. A few quick items we need to proceed: 

- Latest SOC 2 Type II report (or draft) and the auditor's name.
- Audit period covered (start/end dates). We need to confirm coverage for our procurement window (Mar 1–Aug 31, 2026).
- Bridge letter or any interim assurance if the report doesn't fully cover that window.
- A short manifest of controls/systems in-scope (hosted API, dedicated deployments, private deployments) and any exclusions.

Can you also confirm acceptable transfer methods for artifacts (SFTP, secure Drive link, or encrypted email) and an approximate ETA? Our auditor (BrightPath) prefers a packaged artifact plus a manifest CSV.

Thanks — would love a reply by EOD Wednesday if possible.

Best,
Sarah
Sarah Lee
Vendor Risk Manager, Acme Technology

-----

From: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@acmetech.com>
Cc: BrightPath Audits <audits@brightpath.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 11 Jan 2027 10:08:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II — initial ask + audit period question

Hi Sarah — thanks for the clear list. Quick summary / plan below and a couple of clarifying asks.

What we can provide now:
- Redwood SOC 2 Type II report (most recent issued report) — attached as redwood-soc2-summary.pdf. Auditor: BrightPath Audits (we engaged them for the period).
- Bridge-letter options: we can provide a standard bridge-letter-sample.pdf (covers limited gaps where the audit period doesn't align).
- Evidence manifest template (CSV) that maps artifacts to control IDs — attached evidence-manifest-template.csv.

Audit period / coverage note:
- Our most recent Type II report covers 2025-09-01 through 2026-08-31. If you need coverage that specifically includes March–Aug 2026, the existing report does include that window. If you need continuous coverage beyond 2026-08-31, we can provide a bridge letter for the gap between report end and the next audit issuance.

Clarifying asks for your auditor (to avoid back-and-forth):
1) Which transfer method do you prefer? We can stage artifacts to a secured, read-only Google Drive folder (recommended) or provision an SFTP drop with one-time credentials.
2) Do you require raw logs or redacted telemetry samples? We generally provide redacted examples and summaries; raw logs can be shared under an NDA/secure transfer if required.
3) Please confirm the list of Redwood components you want explicitly covered (hosted API, Dedicated reserved capacity, and Private/VPC deployments). That affects our manifest mapping.

ETA: If you confirm transfer method and scope by EOD Tue (11th), we can stage the package by Wed EOD.

Thanks — copying Priyom who will own the artifact staging and delivery.

— Aditya
Aditya Rao
Head of Security Partnerships, Redwood Inference

-----

From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@acmetech.com>
Cc: BrightPath Audits <audits@brightpath.com>
Date: Wed, 12 Jan 2027 08:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II — initial ask + audit period question

Sarah — thanks, we can go ahead with a secure Drive staging folder unless Acme requires SFTP. Per Aditya's note, the Type II report covers 2025-09-01 — 2026-08-31, so March–Aug 2026 is included.

Action items for us (internal):
- Prepare redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (final report) — attached.
- Prepare bridge-letter-sample.pdf (if needed for any partial gaps).
- Populate evidence-manifest-template.csv with sample rows mapping to control IDs (we'll redact any sensitive identifiers).

Delivery plan:
- Create read-only Google Drive folder and grant Acme + BrightPath access (folder + zipped artifacts).
- Generate a short readme (README_TRANSFER.txt) listing artifacts, retention expectations, and contact for follow-up.

I'll stage the Drive folder today and post the link. Priyom

-----

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@acmetech.com>
Cc: BrightPath Audits <audits@brightpath.com>
Date: Thu, 13 Jan 2027 09:35:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II — initial ask + audit period question

Adding one small clarification on scope mapping that often reduces reviewer questions: please indicate whether the following are 'in-scope' or 'out-of-scope' in the manifest rows: 
- Customer-managed Private deployments (VPC/on-prem) — typically out-of-scope by default, but we will mark per-account coverage where customers purchased Private.
- Dedicated reserved capacity — in-scope when covered by contract in the relevant period.
- Hosted API (public) — in-scope for all production tenants.

If Acme wants Private deployments included for their specific tenancy, note that in an email and we'll annotate the manifest with customer-specific coverage.

-----

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.com>, Sarah Lee <sarah.lee@acmetech.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Jan 2027 14:22:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II — initial ask + audit period question

Quick note: the bridge-letter template is fine to share as-is for procurement teams — it explicitly states the report coverage dates and provides the limited assurance language they expect. Approving the Drive staging approach as well.

Will monitor for any follow-up from BrightPath.

Best,
Rishi
VP, Customer Security & Trust

-----

Attachments referenced in this thread (stubs):
- redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (SOC 2 Type II report, PDF, 1.8MB)
- bridge-letter-sample.pdf (Bridge letter template, PDF, 18KB)
- evidence-manifest-template.csv (CSV mapping: Control ID,Artifact,Owner,Retention,RedactionNotes)

Delivery link (staged after confirmation): https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2B3cRedwood/SOC2-onboarding
